# Cedar Plains Community Bank — Incident Response and Business Continuity Plan (excerpt)

## Institution

Cedar Plains Community Bank (FDIC Cert #58231, routing number 011000999) operates the Main Office, the Riverside Branch, the Oak Hill Branch and Branch 7 in the grocery store on Route 9.

## ATMs

Drive-up ATMs are ATM 0412 at the Riverside Branch and ATM 0415 at the Oak Hill Branch. ITM 3 serves the Main Office lobby.

## Cash and vault

Teller Drawers 1–6 at the Main Office balance to Vault A each evening.

## Regulator notices

The Chief Risk Officer notifies the FDIC within 36 hours of determining that a notification incident has occurred, and the state Department of Financial Institutions the same day. The BSA/AML Officer files SARs with FinCEN and screens ransom wallets against OFAC lists.
